title: Phimosis treatment for boys
what: The doctor frees a tight foreskin so the head of the penis can show. Sometimes a cream is enough, sometimes a small surgery is needed.
why: When the foreskin will not open and causes problems: infections, ballooning when peeing, or scarring. In little boys, a tight foreskin is often normal.
duration: a consultation takes 15 to 20 minutes; surgery usually takes 15 to 40 minutes, and you go home the same day
tell_doctor: How your child pees: does the skin balloon, is the stream thin
A cold in the past 2 weeks, if anesthesia is planned
Any blood disorders or bleeding problems in the family

prepare.title: No force
prepare.text: Do not pull the foreskin back by force at home. It causes harm and scarring.

prepare.title: Numbing
prepare.text: In children, surgery is usually done under general anesthesia, sometimes with local numbing. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: If there will be anesthesia, the clinic will set the times for no food and water.

steps: The doctor examines your child and decides: cream or surgery
If surgery, your child falls asleep under anesthesia
The doctor cuts open or removes the tight part of the foreskin
Ointment and a light dressing are applied
feel: For the first 2 to 3 days, it hurts and stings when peeing
Swelling and redness are normal and pass
Your child may be afraid to pee. A warm bath helps
after: Loose underwear for the first days
Care and baths as the doctor says
Stitches usually dissolve on their own in 1 to 3 weeks
Active play when the doctor allows
red_flags: Your child cannot pee for several hours
Bleeding that does not stop with pressure
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), pus, or strong swelling

faq.q: Is it normal that my baby's foreskin does not pull back?
faq.a: Yes, in little boys it is often normal. Many cases resolve on their own with age.
A course of cream often helps. Surgery is needed if the cream does not work or there is scarring.

reminders.text: Your son's procedure is tomorrow. If there is anesthesia, food and water only until the time the clinic gave you.
